companyDescription: CNS / ketamine · KETAFREE (preservative-free IV ketamine) ANDA approved Oct 30, 2026 ahead of its Nov 10 goal date; the bigger NRX-100 NDA (suicidal depression) is not yet filed; NRX-101 and a small HOPE ketamine-clinic network round it out
priceNote: Live $2.40 (+7.1%) on Nov 4, 2026 — down ~4% from $2.51 at the Oct 26 report despite the Oct 30 approval (sell-the-news); 52-week range $1.62-$5.06. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026): the binary resolved positively — FDA approved the KETAFREE (preservative-free ketamine) ANDA on Oct 30, ahead of the Nov 10 GDUFA goal — and the stock still slipped ~4%. That is the generic-approval lesson: a commoditized ANDA doesn't re-rate a going-concern company on its own. The next value events are the Nov 16 Q3 call (launch timing, first orders, cash) and the much larger NRX-100 NDA for suicidal depression, which has been guided and slipped three times and is still not filed. Base cut from +60% to +35%. ⚠️ SURVIVAL: going-concern language in the Jun 30 10-Q, ~$26.7M cash vs ~$2.2M/month burn, active ATM — dilution into the launch is the base case. fda_decision remains a Tier-2 LEADER (+9.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=10), but this pick's binary is already spent. แนะนำ 1% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50-70%.

catalysts.name: KETAFREE ANDA — approved Oct 30
catalysts.description: FDA approved the preservative-free ketamine ANDA ahead of the Nov 10 GDUFA goal date. Stock reaction was flat-to-negative.

catalysts.name: NRX-100 NDA filing (suicidal depression)
catalysts.description: The high-value asset; Fast Track. Filing guided and slipped three times (most recently 'end of Q3 2026'), tied to the luer-lock vial fix.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: going-concern doubt in the Jun 30, 2026 10-Q; ~$26.7M cash vs ~$13.2M H1 operating burn (~12 months), active ATM ($11.8M net in H1). More dilution into the launch is the base case.
Approval didn't re-rate the stock: KETAFREE is a generic-pathway ketamine in a commoditized market. Revenue ramp, not the label, is now the test.
NRX-100 NDA has slipped three times and is still unfiled; the large-value story is undated.
The benzethonium-chloride petition campaign drew contested coverage; reputational friction could cut either way.
The $38.50 consensus comes from four small-shop analysts (BTIG at $10 is the realistic anchor).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A going-concern micro-cap is the most rate-sensitive profile in the market. Tighter financial conditions raise the cost and likelihood of the next ATM draw, and the 'approval then raise' pattern gets worse when risk appetite is thin.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a micro-cap funding its launch through an ATM is directly exposed to a December hike and risk-off small-cap tape.

catalystSpot.preRunup: The run-up into the GDUFA date faded: the stock fell from $2.51 (Oct 26) to ~$2.24 after the Oct 30 approval before bouncing to $2.40 — a sell-the-news reaction to a generic approval.

postWin.note: PharmaTher (PHRM.CN) gained 148% in the six months after FDA approved its KETARx ketamine on Aug 8, 2025. That is a 6-month move, not a day-1 pop, and it is the only ketamine-approval precedent found. Treat it as an upper reference, not an expectation.

postLose.note: Average of two real 2025 small-cap CRLs: Capricor -33% in one day (Jul 11, 2025) and Outlook Therapeutics ~-80% after hours (Dec 31, 2025). With going-concern language, NRXP sits closer to the Outlook end if FDA asks for another cycle.

spotSizing.reason: 1%. fda_decision is a Tier-2 LEADER (+9.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=10), but this pick's FDA binary has already resolved without a move; what remains is a going-concern launch. Size reflects the survival flag, not the catalyst type.

comparableCases.event: FDA approval of KETARx (ketamine) after two prior rejections
comparableCases.note: Closest product comparable: a micro-cap ketamine approval that re-rated the stock. The move took about six months, and the company then sold US rights for $25M+ in milestones. A ketamine approval can be worth more as a licensing asset than as an in-house launch.

comparableCases.event: Complete Response Letter for ONS-5010 BLA
comparableCases.note: Downside template for a cash-strapped small cap that misses an FDA date: CMC and inspection issues were cited, and the stock lost ~80% after hours. NRXP's open CMC item (the vial connector) is the analogous risk.

comparableCases.event: Complete Response Letter for deramiocel BLA
comparableCases.note: Milder CRL case (-33% day-1) for a company with more cash. It shows the range between a survivable rejection and a going-concern rejection.

(กำหนดเปิดตัว ออร์เดอร์แรก เงินสด) และ NDA ของ NRX-100 สำหรับภาวะซึมเศร้าที่มีความคิดฆ่าตัวตาย ซึ่งเลื่อนมาแล้วสามครั้งและยังไม่ยื่น Base ลดจาก +60% เหลือ +35% ⚠️ SURVIVAL: มีภาษา going-concern ใน 10-Q 30 มิ.ย. เงินสด ~$26.7M เทียบเผาเงิน ~$2.2M/เดือน ใช้ ATM อยู่ — การเพิ่มทุนช่วงเปิดตัวคือกรณีหลัก fda_decision ยังเป็น Tier-2 LEADER แต่ binary ของตัวนี้ใช้ไปแล้ว แนะนำ 1% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50-70%
